---
title: "Checklist for Quarto Accessible Book"
---

[Quarto](https://quarto.org) is a powerful tool to compile and publish code notebooks to a wide variety of formats, including websites. Below are the broad steps to use Quarto to improve the digital accessibiilty of code notebooks.


1. [Create a new Quarto book](#create_quarto_book). If you are converting materials from R Markdown to Quart, see [Chapter 3: Creating a Quarto Book from R Markdown](#convert_Q).

2. Make adjustments to ensure that the final document complies with digital accessibility requirements. Go through each of these requirements to ensure compliance.

    a. [Color Contrast](#color_contrast)

    b. [Structure](#structure)

    c. [Alternative Text](#alt_text)

    d. [Accessible Math](#math_1)

    e. [Aria](#aria)

    f. [Tables](#Table_1)
